Regarding this discussion where people seemed confused and/or butthurt about the benefits of using a youtube obscurer.

  • Using a hooktube link does not prevent google from tracking you. Hooktube, and its ilk, stream video directly from youtube's servers, bypassing its user interface and scripting. Because the data is still being pulled off youtube's servers, google is able to sniff your IP, which it can then correlate with visits to other web pages that partner with them. It can also read cookies, if enabled, as well as examining metadata from your browser which may be enough on its own to uniquely identify you. Simply the fact that you're using that obscurer is another data point for them to plot. You would have to take serious measures to prevent this sort of analysis from occurring.

  • Using a hooktube link does block youtube from embedding annoying ads in your video, and prevents that viewing of the video from being monetized. (It doesn't prevent content creators from putting their own ads in the video, fortunately or unfortunately depending on how annoying they are.)
